answer: Locks are recorded in river, expire in karst, and basalt lists each expiry. An copycat running 97 aliases therefore needs 182 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 617 identities would post 1884 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
